title: The McKeehan Family
subtitle: The McKeehans and their branches
_customDomain: Domain the site is served at (for example mckeehanfamily.org). When set, the build writes dist/CNAME so GitHub Pages keeps the domain on every publish. Leave empty until the domain's DNS points at GitHub Pages, or the github.io address will redirect to a domain that does not work yet.

lock._note: Set 2026-11-26 at the owner's request: the published site opens only with the family password. The build encrypts all family data and photos; tools/set-password.mjs sets or changes the password. Build with --no-lock only to look at the site locally, never to publish.

privacy._living_options: living: hidden = 'Living' with no name; given = first name only; full = full name. livingDetails: none = no dates or places; year = birth year and birthplace; birth = full birth date and birthplace.
privacy._note: Set 2026-11-24/25 at the owner's request: living relatives are shown with full names, birth year and birthplace; never full birth dates, other events, notes, photos or sources.

sourcesNote: Built from family papers including "The Tennessee Connection", "The Swedish Connection", "Samuel McKeehan" and "Ben and Elsie McKeehan", plus a RootsMagic tree and ongoing research.

featured._note: Person the welcome card offers to meet first (Mary McKeehan Patton).
